2123153520635297814.en_summary: Nvidia $NVDA is moving up pay raises and stock grants to hold on to employees after Jensen Huang’s exit, per WIRED. At her first all-hands meeting as interim CEO, Colette Kress told staff they’ll get raises and additional equity in December, months earlier than planned. Pay was the top issue among about 700 questions; board transparency next but unaddressed. Thousands lobbied for Huang’s return, but board chair Harvey Jones said Huang won’t be invited back.
2123153520635297814.zh_summary: Nvidia $NVDA 正在提前加薪和股票授予，以在 Jensen Huang 離任後留住員工，據 WIRED。臨時執行長 Colette Kress 在首次全體會議上告訴員工，他們將在十二月獲得加薪和額外股權，比計劃提前數月。薪酬是約 700 個問題中的首要問題；董事會透明度其次但未解決。數千名員工遊說 Huang 回歸，但董事會主席 Harvey Jones 表示不會邀請 Huang 回來。

2123152505039114426.en_summary: I've been seeing a lot of doomsday-level short positions on AI infra. Thesis: if Jensen has been propping up chip prices through circular financing and that unravels, neoclouds' rented chips could be worth half what paid, devouring them by debt. $NBIS has $14B debt on ~$35B company. Would reset prices for Google TPUs, GPU rentals, data centers, power deals, memory and networking suppliers. Very bad short-term news for debt-laden tech like $AMZN, $META, $GOOGL. Not financial advice. Quoted: It’s so over… $NBIS
2123152505039114426.zh_summary: 我一直看到許多對 AI 基礎設施的末日級空頭部位。論點：如果 Jensen 一直透過循環融資支撐晶片價格而這點瓦解，新雲端租用的晶片可能只值支付價格的一半，被債務吞噬。$NBIS 作為約 350 億美元公司有 140 億美元債務。將重設 Google TPU、GPU 租賃、數據中心、電力交易、記憶體和網路供應商的價格。對背負債務的科技公司如 $AMZN、$META、$GOOGL 短期非常壞消息。非投資建議。引用：結束了… $NBIS
